archimate:ApplicationInterface.name: AP -> ERP
archimate:ApplicationInterface.documentation: Invoicing, Fees, and Accounts Payable (AP) Direction: Aladdin ⟶ ERP AP Payload: Management fees, incentive/performance fees, custodian fees, and broker commissions calculated inside Aladdin or eFront. These flow into the ERP’s AP module to issue payments and trigger corporate expense recognition.
